comment: Overrides for scripts/rust-notices.py: crates linked into Foldover.app that publish no license text, plus UniFFI template code outside the crate graph. rust/ holds verbatim upstream files (each reason names its source); spdx/ holds canonical SPDX texts from fetch-spdx-texts.py (license-list-data v3.29.0). Versions are pinned so an upgrade fails the generator until the entry is checked again.

crates.name: objc2
crates.reason: Publishes no license file; MIT per Cargo.toml and LICENSE.md in github.com/madsmtm/objc2 at tag objc2-0.6.5. Upstream later added the MIT text for every crate in the repository as LICENSE-MIT.txt (commit ee9a7ada2131, 2026-03-18); that file is copied verbatim

crates.name: objc2-encode
crates.reason: Same repository and terms as objc2 (MIT-only per LICENSE.md at tag objc2-encode-4.1.0); same text

crates.name: block2
crates.reason: Same repository and terms as objc2 (MIT-only per LICENSE.md at tag block2-0.6.2); same text

crates.name: uniffi*
crates.reason: uniffi, uniffi_core and uniffi_pipeline publish no license file; MPL-2.0 per Cargo.toml and LICENSE in github.com/mozilla/uniffi-rs. Used unmodified; the Source Code Form line is generated from the crates.io source. Pinned with foldover-ffi's =0.32.2

extra.name: UniFFI-generated Swift bindings (uniffi_bindgen templates)
extra.note: apple/FoldoverCore/Sources and Headers, compiled into the app, are generated by uniffi_bindgen 0.32.2 and contain code from its MPL-2.0 Swift and C templates, used unmodified (template source: https://static.crates.io/crates/uniffi_bindgen/uniffi_bindgen-0.32.2.crate).
extra.reason: uniffi_bindgen runs at build time (foldover-bindgen), so it is not in the shipped crate graph, but its template output ships in the app
